name: GET /api/leadflow/pipeline/board - stage columns with the targets
description:
Stage columns with the age of the oldest record in each, plus the two hard pipeline targets.

THE TARGETS ARE RAW COUNTS, NOT PERCENTAGES. 99.4% owned sounds like success and is forty leads nobody is working; zero is a number somebody can act on and argue with.
